column1: # Vendored copy of the rollforward gate runner. v1018-D026.
# CM051 is PUBLIC and OS003 is PRIVATE, so the tag pipeline cannot check OS003
# out without a PAT secret in a public repo -- the exact cross-org resolution
# that already failed once (task #204). The copy lives here instead, and OS003
# CI asserts parity against it (OS003 can read public CM051 with no token; the
# reverse is not true). Direction of the check matters.
